items.title: Disregarded Seeing Me Post-SXM

items.description:
AEM I left out and he was very responsive to making sure I was on the plane, asked for consistent updates all the way until 4am CST the next day when I made it to the hotel. Very attentive and caring in this situation.
* While I was actually in LA, that Friday evening, Saturday and Sunday into Monday when I got back, he was texting much less and barely at all. I sent him updates with photos on what I was doing and going around seeing in the city.
* I felt that there was something pulling away. He did got out with the big group of our guy friends and was around a lot of women so he did get attention that his ego was craving after I send these sexy photos and his sexual tension is high. He needed physical attention while I was away and posted IG reel that was a complete thirst trap. I could tell with all of this,  the energy was shifting and certainly did shift
* Coming back from an amazing experience, I wasn’t bothered about it as much but I did ask him if he was free Monday/Tuesday and he said that this week was bad bc he had to take a day trip to “West Texas” for work. I asked and confirmed that he would be back on the same day (Tuesday). So I was confused when he said that he had to postpone the entire week.
* I decided to detach and take action it on that Friday. I had my DND on my phone and stopped carrying the convo. I let it die out and I told him that I would be going out and I hope hes safe when he goes out. He said “You be safe. Be hydrated and get something to eat.”
* I started my nap and then as I’m decompressing and trying to get him out of my system mentally to move forward without a deep attachment, he calls me four times then pulls up to my house ( after I said that I was at home).
* I had to rush to clean my apt and take a shower to freshen up before he came upstairs.
* We had sex and were intimate after catching up, me giving him hugs and kisses and having a few shots
* I was at the middle of my period and I didn’t want him to know that actually and couldn’t resist being sexual when the tension was high. Idk if he noticed or not, but maybe he did. Because now that its a week later, he hasn’t scheduled to try to see me since then.
* Since that week long of time, he’s been out with coworkers and friends (male/female), but hasn’t made the effort to be with me outside of the house or even at each others houses.
* We’ve been texting saying that we miss each other and that we can’t wait until we get to cuddle and see each other again…. But no effort to plan a day has been made or shown.
* It makes me feel like I should completely not get caught up and actually think into a delusion that he wants to be more than sexual and have more intention with me. It is jarring of the contrast that we have. Example of pre-puffcon and post-puffcon is different
* Tonight he said he was going out bc his homeboy was throwing a surprise bday party for his gf. I said that was sweet and he asked me the same. I lied and said that Ill be going to dinner and a drink.
* He made a comment about needing to leave his function in time to get rest for work tomorrow and I told him that he should set an alarm or reminder on his phone so when it strikes, hes out. He laughed and said thats why Im awesome and he will do that tonight. I laughed and send a cool GIF. No text response bc Idk what else to say. He laughed at the GIF and thats it. I put my phone back on DND.

He was like “if I was the owner or bartender, I would’ve denied you well… brought you through the back door but that’s beside the point”. He made another comment of how he would “hit it from the back just needs 5 minutes. Would eat it from the back bc how good the outfit is” He asked if I wore a sweater or jacket with it 🤭😭 which I did. He seemed relieved. It was cute hearing him express himself like that with me since he plays it super cool and nonchalant 99.99% of the time.
* NOTE: he likes assertiveness and command from a woman lol. That’s what I sense from it. He asked me to tell him what I want and to say it.
* He did call me babes and baby last night.
* I’ve seen him out once this month. We did speak a few times and make interesting contact from a distance. Afterwards of course flirty messages were exchanged and he wanted me to drive over but I was too tipsy.  He said I should uber but thankfully I declined the offer.
* With my knee injury, he’s been super helpful with tips and seems to care about my betterment. One thing is, we’re sexting and making jokes about what will happen when I’m better. He hasn’t mentioned coming to check on me or see me at all but only when I’m healed for sexual pleasure. Having new reflective thoughts about pulling back after other experiences with Alex.  He went out with the guys and if he can schedule time with other men, he could surely set time to see me out of care, no guarantee of sex to check on me. But I’m understanding again what it is & how I need to chill out.

items.title: Is This What I Need?

items.description:
AEM Response “Woke randomly for some reason don’t see myself going back to sleep.
Firstly I love the hair, looks absolutely beautiful on you.
You’ve been nothing short of amazing to me. Me attempting to coach you back to health was not me wanting or trying to get anything out of you (not accusing you) … but it was me caring for a person that I absolutely adore.
From the similar interests, to your smile, to your beauty, to your amazing smile - it’ll be shameful if I didn’t mention your overall aura, breath taking if you ask me.
Yes i remember the conversation, and I wouldn’t want to be open and honest to an amazing person like yourself.
You deserve the most amazing person ..I’m just not in the position to offer that to you. Don’t change a thing about yourself, not one thing..
Given why I want to do in life, and where I wanna go in life..and in addition to how my life has been going.. quite honestly it’s not in my best interest to be selfish and keep you to myself when I know you absolutely deserve everything.
I adore you, I don’t mind doing anything for you no matter how inconvenient it may seem. Some may call it the L word..it’ll be hard for me to deny it.
I’m sure I’ll see you eventually, I pray our interactions stay the same- if not..no harm no foul.
Whatever you need whatever you want I’m here, even if it’s a listening ear. Ultimately you deserve it all - all isn’t what I have to offer.
You’re amazing, you’re beautiful don’t change- please 🤍
My responses:
Good morning 🌞
I truly appreciate the vulnerability in your response, kind words, and affirmations. 🫶🏾 They mean more than I can say!
I understand where you’re coming from & have the utmost respect for it. Me being the person that I am, will surely honor that. It’s no harm done at all.
Our interactions won’t change, except for our sensual moments, so I don’t get caught up more than I am. (Which I’m realizing that it’s more than what I initially thought, as I type this)
But again, thank you for communicating all of this to me. I’m here for you as well for support or if you ever need a listening ear, especially when you lock down that British accent lol.
I don’t regret the genuine connection that I feel like we’ve built after all of this time of knowing each other.
I hope you have an amazing weekend. (March 16th 2026)

items.title: We’ve been having very intimate conversations over
items.text:
we’ve been having very intimate conversations over the past few months and heavier these past weeks. With sexual tension and all. For the first time, this person gave me oral sex after two years of knowing them and me being the only one giving oral. Even on my period once, when I told him it was that week in person after being hot and heavy. He still asked for oral and I did it at the time. So now that he crossed that mark, he seemed to enjoy it and has foreplay texts heavily invoking that. In my opinion I felt flattered because at this point I can tell it’s not something he’s done much or willingly does for a woman.
* Last week when coming back from Florida, I was extremely exhausted and expressed that concern over to him. He did check on me to make sure I made it home safely. After a lil bit I started painting my nails which takes me an average of 3-4 hours when I’m not sleepy. He texted me saying that he was very horny and I expressed being tired and doing my nails. He asked me to stop whatever I was doing and drive over which is 20-25 mins away. Knowing that the tension was high and remembering that he said I don’t use my free will enough with him, I went over.
* This is the night of the passionate intimacy and him giving me oral sex. We did things that we haven’t done in a more “I missed you” type of way. Afterwards, it was 3am and we both had work. His body language was saying for me to leave after cuddling for 8 mins max or so. He mentioned the time and how he might sleep on the couch. I know that means “don’t get comfortable, go home”. I went to the bathroom then got courage to ask if I could take a nap there and get up in the morning bc after working, going straight to the airport, doing travel related stuff then getting home, try to paint my nails that u didn’t get to finish upon HIS REQUEST then drive over… I could use any rest no matter the amount of time. He said he thinks it’s best I go home so I don’t have to wake up twice for work. Usually I totally understand but that day, I felt like he was very selfish for inconveniencing me then kicking me out at almost 3:30am. I quickly left and didn’t hang around.

With business, he texted me again hours later from my no response to check in. I expressed my stare at that time. Getting home at 9pm. No food all day and barely water. I told him how laying in the floor feels phenomenal when you’re exhausted and he agreed. He started talking sexy talk. & I mentioned how I would love to see him tomorrow (today) after he’s off work to avoid being sent home in dangerous hours. He said “ok babes”. Then proceeded with digits fore play. At thus time, I snacked on beef jerky and sat for 15 mins tops before tackling my closet and bedroom. On go nonstop all day. He basically kept saying how he wanted me NOW. It was 2:20am, not sure how I was functioning. Here’s a screenshot of the final interaction where I was advocating for myself to avoid another repeat.

items.title: I went over to his house last
items.text:
I went over to his house last night. He asked if I was spending the night ahead of asking me to come over which I really liked🥹. It’s hard leaving immediately and so late at that. I brought the paddle, cuffs and a toy that I used to use. Very interesting night. About 3-4 rounds. I left on my own accord in the morning around 9am. We’ve been texting consistently all day which isn’t anything new for us. Curious to see what will occur. I am at the point again where I don’t want to be too drawn into him and whatever this sexual flint is. I’m very aware that I should be going back to the stance that I had earlier this year when I was talking to AJT and asked AEM serious questions about potentially moving forward but I also am aware of that conversation and have to know that I’m putting myself in this situation first hand.
* I’m thinking about not necessarily comparing myself to the women he follows on socials but taking note that he does have options, as do I.
* When I look back at the calendar, I’ve seen him once a week for the past 8 weeks besides the weekend of Jeremy’s birthday celebrations. I saw him out the entire time but didn’t spend personal time with him that weekend of Aug. 13th.
* I’m thinking I should pull back because I know how I am once I start doing certain things with someone especially sexually. For one I shouldn’t be doing it in the first place then when I’m not exclusive with them I start to feel weird bc naturally I want to be territorial since I’m opening myself up in ways that can leave me out & messed up. I don’t want him to be with any other woman sexually or even emotionally connected to another woman but I’m very aware of the current situation until otherwise. Even though he said the comment about free will, it doesn’t mean that we’re exclusively together.
* I’ve noticed that he does check in on me a lot when I don’t text back immediately. The last two intimate moments were very new for us both to do together. Even though we’ve always had great sexual chemistry and attraction. We were meshed well at first in 2024 where he did allow me to stay at his house while he wasn’t there and trusted me to lock up. I found that very impressive on his end of showing interest. I used to wash his dishes and make up his bed before I would go. He also used to tell me to work at his house some mornings too. Thinking about the organic moments that we did have that honestly said a lot because no one especially men are going to allow someone to stay at their house so freely without them there and without a connection in a certain way.
- [ ] 09/09/26: I’m pulling back from the connection as I know when things are this complicated and over drawn out it can lead to disappointment and mixed feelings. This past few days I’ve feel like I’m reflecting on the past opportunities that I could’ve been in a relationship or did grow in time to know someone and they left me high and dry right now I feel triggered about all of those failed moments and situations. When AEM draws back… it’s too much hot and cold when we just went further than a previous threshold.
* It’s starting to make me question myself which isn’t something that I should be doing. I know my worth and my effort when it comes to liking someone. I’m about to start my perks so maybe it’s that to but I do know that the things we did do, crossed danger zones. Completely.
* To post about calling someone your baby then not call me not one pet name that day threw me off bc who are you talking to?

items.text: The rest of the days after leading up to the fish fry, we were talking all day long and that Friday before he didn’t message back and that was fine. I was busy anyway and also understand that he was getting ready to host over 100 people at his house at once.

items.title: For the fish fry
items.text: For the fish fry, I did follow up with him making sure that he knew everything would be fine and that the party would be a hit. All of the effort he’s put into it and the deeper opening conversations of him putting it all together would work out in the best way. I asked if he needed anything and he said no but I insisted that it could be anything. He asked for ice and mixers. I told him I’d bring at least ten each and did. The party was fun with my friends and mutuals that we have together. I didn’t see any women on him like that. We had many flirty moments of us texting back and forth during the function & when I went up to him to flirt while he was prepping the fryer for the fish outside. Super nice and very tempting. When I left his house, I immediately had a blow out and had to call a tow company. I told AEM about it and he was concerned. I told him the tow was on the way and I didn’t hear back immediately from him. I know he was busy and inebriated at that time of past midnight and almost 1am. I got home and my phone died. He asked if I was okay that night when it was def and followed up in the morning. He eventually said he was sorry about it happening and felt bad even though it was out of his control (my words). Before the party started I asked if his family would be staying with him and hinted that I would like to spend the night so in that moment, I do wish he asked me to drive back but with the tow only being 10mins out and him knowing about the service I pay for, it probably reassured him a tad and again he was hosting. Bittersweet feeling.

items.title: As of today days later he’s been
items.text:
As of today days later he’s been apologetic over the situation. My outfit that night was a HIT and he was eating out the palms of my hand. Along with others even up until now present day about it. Which is nice… I asked if we could see each other tonight and he rejected since his place is a mess from the party or not up to par. But again, earlier today he said it wasn’t bad of a mess. I’m sure he’s tired and also could assume other things. I’m not going to push it. I was so sad when my tire busted and I’m just having more realizations as I used to that I could be getting caught up and moving ahead of myself. I feel detached that I’m wanting to call him mine but he’s not as we haven’t made it official. Conflicting but we’ll see. He said for me to pencil him in again on Thursday night which I believe is his “Sunday” of the week. At least he mentioned a day I guess.
* Two things, I was the only woman he reposted on his story from his fish fry.
* I saw that he went to a vendor function that’s popular in the city in Sunday and living his best life but didn’t come physically check on me even though he was on IG DMing me back to back. He wasn’t messaging me that much on Sunday and I see why.
* Now, I do feel like I’m setting myself up to get hurt much more than the last time. I have so many men who want to date me and I don’t like overlapping with others or dating too many people at once. It’s hard to spread yourself thin in that way. And this go around, I’m putting a lot of energy into someone who isn’t exclusively mine and may very well never be. I need to sit and think to myself.
